data.exact_reserve_text: Favourable movements of GBP 0.4 million, (2017: GBP 11.2 million favourable) in the past year's provision for claims outstanding, net of expected reinsurance recoveries, are included in claims incurred, net of reinsurance.
data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2018 the syndicate's gross claims outstanding (opening reserves) were GBP 369.552m. The gross movement in prior year provisions for the year is immaterial (gross movement +GBP 0.002m, a very small strengthening), while the report records a net favourable movement of GBP 0.4m after reinsurance recoveries. The small gross strengthening and the net release reflect movements in prior-year case reserves and reinsurance recoveries; the note also shows a significant RITC take-on of reserves during the year which materially increased gross claims outstanding on the balance sheet.
raw_causal_phrases: Favourable movements of GBP 0.4 million, (2017: GBP 11.2 million favourable) in the past year's provision for claims outstanding, net of expected reinsurance recoveries, are included in claims incurred, net of reinsurance.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken from Statement of Financial Position (Claims outstanding, prior year column). Prior year development: gross movement read from the technical provisions reconciliation table (shown as 'Change in prior year provisions' = 2 (GBP '000) gross) - this is a very small gross strengthening while the narrative reports a net favourable movement of GBP 0.4m after reinsurance recoveries. The presence of a large RITC take-on (1,251,064 GBP '000) materially affects gross reserves and complicates triangle interpretation. Many small per-class prior-year movements in note 6 are presented net of reinsurance; gross per-LOB prior year movements are not clearly reported. Some premium line items in the breakdown are negative (adjustments) - figures copied verbatim from the analysis table.
